blocked.name: Two-leg same-week parlay (joint-evidence gate)
blocked.rule: Combine two legs only when a directly validated joint probability exists. Marginal probabilities may not be multiplied: dependence inside a game and across a slate makes the product wrong in both directions.
blocked.why: Parlays are where most claimed edges live and where they are least verifiable.
blocked.promote: A joint probability validated on held-out data, plus the operator's void and push rules, plus a settled sample with push handling.
blocked.kill: No joint estimate exists → the strategy stays BLOCKED, not 'promising'.
blocked.blocked_by: G07 joint-evidence gate: no validated joint probability is available.

blocked.name: Player-prop combination (joint-evidence gate)
blocked.rule: Rank a prop combination only when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.
blocked.why: Props are correlated within a game (pace, game script, weather). Multiplying marginals is invalid.
blocked.promote: A validated joint model with held-out calibration and settled grading.
blocked.kill: No prop outcome feed exists → stays BLOCKED.
blocked.blocked_by: G07 + G08: no validated joint probability and no prop settlement feed.
